end.parentNote: Kabir practised rounding numbers and explaining whether an answer makes sense in the story. They explained 4,982 as near 5,000 and 3,015 as near 3,000 to estimate 8,000. A mix-up remained: they continued to expect the exact answer to match the estimate, so this was not corrected after the last example. At home, ask Kabir to estimate one calculation first, then compare the estimate with the exact answer and discuss why they need not be identical.
